title: One Step of Gradient Descent on x Squared

input.request: explain gradient descent with one worked example

description:
The learner sees how gradient descent uses the slope to take one step downhill, from x = 3 to x = 2.4 on the curve x squared.
Scene 1 (10 s): Gradient descent moves against the slope: new x = old x minus step size times slope.
Narrated by one voice; 1 scenes; 10 seconds.
